spans.s: --taught Atri the consequences of dis- astrous signs in a state. M. २२९. 2.
--a contemporary of Mucukunda; told the latter that towards the end of द्वापर he would have the दर्शन् of कृष्ण Vis2n2u. Vi. V. २३. २५८.

--of कारूष line, married श्रुत- देवा, sister of Vasudeva. She gave birth to Dantavaktra;
1: भा. IX. २४. ३७; Br. III. ७१. १५६; वा. ९६. १५५; Vi. IV. १४. ३९.
son of आयु.
2: M. २४. ३४.
--a queen of सुमती and mother of Deva- ताजित्. भा. V. १५. 2.

--done prior to मङ्गल occasions such as festivals, sacrifices, marriages, etc.; here prayers offered first to मातृस्, then to पितृस्, maternal grandfather, and विश्- vedevas; in it yava is used for tila and prefaced by नान्दि s4abda;
1: M. १७. ६५ 9; वा. ११०. १७.
a house-holder is eligible to perform it after the सपिण्डि करणम् of the deceased.
2: M. १८. १६.
